question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ga</mi></math> (atomic mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>70</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math>) crystallizes in a hexagonal close packed structure. The total number of voids in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>581</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ga</mi></math> is ________ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>21</mn></msup></math>. (Round off to the Nearest Integer).

solution.text:
HCP structure : Per atom, there will be one octahedral void (OV) and two tetrahedral voids (TV).

Therefore, total three voids per atom are present in HCP structure.

→ Therefore total no. of atoms of Ga will be-

= Mass  Molar Mass ×NA=0.581 g70 g/mol×6.023×1023

→ Now, total Number of voids =3 × total no. of atoms 

=3×0.58170×6.023×1023=14.99×1021

≃15×1021
